disposition: No remaining source-review blocker for the reviewed promotion implementation and canonical-state cutover procedure.
scope: Independent source review and offline fault qualification; actual installed authority, cutover and live promotion need separate receipts.

verification.transport: AWS, GitHub current-run reads and public HTTP responses are synthetic in the lifecycle campaign; real bundle, OCI publisher, canonical budget validator, CAS journal, boundary guards, approval validator and public summary validator execute.

reviewed_behavior: A single conditional S3 state document owns the full ledger and non-expiring promotion lease. Write-ahead intents precede mutations; ambiguous writes or AWS responses retain the lease and cannot automatically replay.

Preparation and execution are bound to the exact candidate, artifact and immutable packet. Current-trunk and exact-CI checks repeat before preparation, after image publication and immediately before stopping services.

Both services must be proved stopped before the exact change-set ARN is executed, and all retained task/secret/alias/schedule boundaries are rechecked before activation. Actual running image URI and the approved index or its verified ARM64 child digest must match; missing health evidence is refused.

The lifecycle tests exercise both OCI root shapes, valid preparation-through-summary, wrong packet/approval/running digest, and lost responses after accepted stop, CloudFormation execution and activation.

Only an operator may abandon a fully prepared, never-executed promotion. The original GitHub run must be terminal for 65 minutes, exceeding the roles one-hour credential lifetime. Unknown outcomes and any execution phase remain locked.

Budget maintenance requires fresh billing evidence, explicit operator assessment and a second actual billing read. It cannot decrease recorded money, rewrite deployment windows, renew expiry or raise caps, and a racing deployment fails the conditional state write.

Cutover checks the original ledger and captures live state again, fences the shared legacy environment before the create-only remote state write, verifies remote readback and retains original local bytes as recovery evidence. Direct legacy preflight and shell entrypoints also refuse the migration marker.
cutover_conditions: Install and independently read back the exact cleared bootstrap roles, OIDC provider and bucket configuration before remote state import.
The install command must pass its fresh live-capture and original-ledger equality checks; any drift requires review rather than updating checksums to force acceptance.
Root remains the sole cloud mutation operator for setup; legacy credentials or programs must not be run as competing deployment writers.
limitations: Offline tests and IAM simulations do not establish live end-to-end success. A real merged-run build, OIDC assumption, reviewed packet, human approval, runtime readback and tag receipt remain required.
The independent reviewer performed no AWS mutations and did not approve a GitHub environment deployment.
Unknown execution outcomes require explicit operator reconciliation. The pipeline does not roll back database migrations or provide an automatic unlock.
A local migration marker fences supported entrypoints; it does not cryptographically revoke administrator credentials or arbitrary historical programs.

followup_verification.scope: Final source fixes after the first review
